Patch Set 2:

(12 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Some concerns, see inline comments. Two hunks change behaviour for everyone, not just when the new tunable is set: lnet_recover_peer_nis() now clears LNET_PEER_NI_RECOVERY_PENDING unconditionally, and lnet_health_check() now clears LNET_PEER_MARK_DELETION unconditionally. Neither is mentioned in the commit message, and both look like they belong behind lnet_del_on_recovery_limit (or in a separate patch) rather than in the default path. The stated restriction that only non-manually-configured peers are removed also doesn't seem to be implemented anywhere.

commit.subject: LU-17519 lnet: automatically remove outdated peers
commit.message:
LU-17519 lnet: automatically remove outdated peers

When a peer is in recovery list, it has a recovery limit.
del_on_recovery_limit has been added to control if an outdated peer
will be simply removed from the recovery list or if it will also be
removed from the peer list. A peer will be removed only when all NIs
age out.

It is important to note that it works only for peers that haven't been
configured manually.

The default value is to keep the peer.
